About the AWP | Fever Dream

High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils. A predator is a predator, no matter the environment The AWP | Fever Dream is a Classified-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Fever Dream finish on the AWP. With a Classified rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.64% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The AWP | Fever Dream can be unboxed from the Spectrum Case. It belongs to the Spectrum Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.55. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The AWP | Fever Dream (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $34.12, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $13.90 (Battle-Scarred) to $34.12 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The AWP | Fever Dream has a community rating of 3.8 out of 5 based on 249 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among AWP skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the AWP | Fever Dream?

Factory New (FN) AWP | Fever Dream skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Fever Dream pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the AWP | Fever Dream a good budget option?

Yes, the AWP | Fever Dream is an excellent budget-friendly choice. Priced affordably, it offers the Fever Dream aesthetic without breaking the bank. Budget skins like this are ideal for players building their first inventory or those who prefer spending on multiple skins rather than one expensive item. The lower price point also means less financial risk if you decide to trade or sell later.

What is the float value range for the AWP | Fever Dream?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.55, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the AWP | Fever Dream?

Prices for the AWP | Fever Dream vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the Spectrum Case or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Compare real-time prices in the market comparison table above to find the best deal.

Can I use the AWP | Fever Dream in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the AWP | Fever Dream are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.

Is the AWP | Fever Dream price going up or down?

The AWP | Fever Dream has remained relatively stable in price recently, with less than 5% movement over the past 7 and 30 days. Stable pricing suggests balanced supply and demand. This can be a good sign for investors looking for low-volatility items, and for buyers it means you're unlikely to overpay. Check the price chart above for longer-term trends.

What collection is the AWP | Fever Dream from?

The AWP | Fever Dream is part of the The Spectrum Collection. It can be obtained by opening the Spectrum Case. All skins from the same collection share a rarity hierarchy, which affects trade-up contract possibilities and overall value.

What is the story behind the AWP | Fever Dream?

The in-game description reads: "High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils. A predator is a predator, no matter the environment" The Fever Dream finish on the AWP is a distinctive design that has made this skin a recognizable part of CS2's visual identity.

Do professional CS2 players use the AWP | Fever Dream?

Yes, 1 professional CS2 players currently have the AWP | Fever Dream in their inventory. Pro player adoption is a strong indicator of a skin's prestige and desirability in the community, and can positively influence its market value.
